title: JSON-to-CSV silently ignores non-array input
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the page does not stay silent: either the CSV output contains Bob and bob@example.test, or a visible message says the input must be an array"

verdict.title: JSON-to-CSV silently ignores non-array input
verdict.oneLiner: Entering a JSON object leaves the CSV output empty without telling the user that an array is required.
verdict.rootCause: The converter received a JSON object rather than an array, but it neither produced CSV nor showed the required validation message.
verdict.suggestion: Show a clear message next to the input when the JSON is valid but is not an array, and keep the output blank only while that message is visible.
